# repo path: # mode: file = one symlink for that file
#       theme = one symlink to ~/.local/state/ryce/theme/current/<repo path>, where <repo path>
#              is relative to themes/<id>/ and must exist in every theme (deploy.sh checks)
#       tree = one symlink PER FILE under the repo dir, mirrored under the home dir
#              (directories are created, never linked: runtime files written by apps
#              never land in the repo). Skips tests/, __pycache__/, *.pyc, README.md.
# Owned by the main thread. Makers request additions in their final report.
# Desktop entries that override a package's: ZapZap is WhatsApp's client, but its own entry
# says only «ZapZap» (rofi never finds it by «whatsapp»), and its no-GPU twin is hidden.
# theme rows: <path inside themes/<id>/>  <home path>  theme — the home path links to
# ~/.local/state/ryce/theme/current/<path>, so `ryce-theme set` moves them all at once.
